data.title: Bel Air the Trump Estate
data.about:
Introducing Bel Air in Damac Hills. Located within the Trump Estates, these limited-edition villas offer you a choice of 4 & 5 bedrooms A high-end lifestyle, that is Californian, contemporary and amazing. 

Check out these amazing homes and live a life that you’ve always dreamt of.

characteristics_module.title: Experience a collection of luxurious villas
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Limited Edition Villas
  • 4 & 5 BR options
  • Amazing Views of the Golf Course
  • Californian Lifestyle
  • 4 BR starting at AED 3.8 million
  • 4-year payment plan
  • Pay 76% until handover
  • Pay 24% after handover
  • Handover – Q3 & Q4 2022
  • Amazing Amenities
  • Access to Trump International Golf Club

location_tile.title: Damac Hills Close to Everything
location_tile.description:
Bel Air is nestled within Damac Hills, in the Trump Estates. This is the crown jewel of the are and offers beautiful green views of the golf course.

  • Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club – 10 minutes
  • Dubai Autodrome – 12 minutes
  • The Plantation Equestrian and Polo Club – 11 minutes
  • Miracle Garden – 13 minutes
  • Dubai International Stadium – 14 minutes
  • Global Village – 14 minutes
  • IMG World – 14 minutes
  • Hamdan Sports Complex – 15 minutes
